featured_reviews.name: Pandurang Pable
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited the snack center and tried their pizza, sandwich, strawberry juice, and chocolate sandwich.

The pizza was flavorful with a perfect crust, and the sandwiches were fresh and delicious.

The strawberry juice was refreshing and made with fresh fruit.

However, the chocolate sandwich was a standout - it was indulgent and satisfying, a perfect treat for chocolate lovers.

Overall, the food quality was excellent, and the variety offered was impressive. I highly recommend trying these items when visiting the snack center!

My experience was delightful not only because of the delicious food but also due to the exceptional service. The staff was incredibly friendly, attentive, and accommodating. They were knowledgeable about the menu and provided recommendations that perfectly matched my preferences.

Moreover, the owner's presence was evident in the attention to detail and the high standards maintained throughout. It's clear that the owner takes pride in the snack center, as reflected in the quality of both the food and service. Their dedication to ensuring a pleasant experience for customers is commendable.

In summary, the snack center not only offers delectable food items such as pizza, sandwiches, strawberry juice, and the exquisite chocolate sandwich but also provides top-notch service and a welcoming environment.

I left feeling satisfied and impressed with both the culinary offerings and the excellent customer care.

It's definitely a place I'll be returning to and recommending to friends and family.

So glad Third Wave Coffee has an outlet here – makes R-City Mall visits even better! Highly recommend.

featured_reviews.review_text: Chacha Juice Wala, located in Ghatkopar MG road just on the left side once taken a right from LBS Marg while going towards Sarvodaya Hospital. As far as I've noticed it is very in their corner & doesn't harm the traffic o anythng because their timings are from 10pm to 1:00am. 1:30am at the max which is quite adjustable with the passing traffic. Everyone should visit this Chacha juice wala atleast once, n it will get you back once again just because of their quality, taste n variety.

What made it worse was the overall attitude — no accountability, no apology, and no effort to improve the situation. It’s one thing to serve bad food, but combining that with such disgusting service makes it a place I would strongly advise everyone to avoid.

Definitely one of the worst experiences I’ve had. Never ordering from here again.

featured_reviews.name: Pavan J
featured_reviews.review_text:
Juice Time - a genuinely disappointing experience.
The staff came across as rude and completely lacking basic hospitality. What made it worse was the poor handling by the manager, who added no value in resolving the situation.

A place can only improve when the good for nothing manager is fired or changed

featured_reviews.name: Aadil Rakhangi
featured_reviews.review_text: Visited this place late evening. Ambience is very very good. Nice place to chill with friends. Had ordered Pita Bread with Hammus. Followed by Pasta. Taste was very good. For cold drink tried the Mulberry Juice. It was again very nice. Overall experience was very nice. Helpful staff. Good service. Definitely would recommend one to visit this place.

featured_reviews.name: The Wandering Veggie
featured_reviews.review_text:
We ordered Falafel Shawarma 🥙, Pasta pe Pasta and Firangi (Peru+Strawberry) Juice 🍹

The Falafel Shawarma  was lovely, hummus, pickled beetroot, other veggies, falafels, everything was perfect.

The Firangi juice had more peru(guava) taste than strawberry, but was fresh and not too sugary. Will definitely try other curious combos the next time.

Pasta pe Pasta was a combination of macaroni in cheesy sauce and speghetti in red sauce, taste was pretty good, the breads served with it were a little dry.

Staff was very nice and let us use the group seating area which could easily accommodate 9-10 people although we were just 2. The ambience is pretty good.

If you advance book through Zomato Gold Dining option and then pay through Zomato Gold, you get flat 15% off on total bill which is a steal deal.
